ApplicationId.description: A stable identifier for a configured application profile.

ProcessExit.description: Reaped Unix child status without unbounded output.

code.description: Normal exit status, mutually exclusive with `signal`.

core_dumped.description: Whether the OS reported a core dump.

ProcessRef.description: A reference safe against desktop restart and Linux PID reuse.

desktop_generation.description: Desktop lifetime that owns the child.

proc_start_ticks.description: Field 22 from `/proc/{pid}/stat`, measured in boot clock ticks.

oneOf.description: Spawn is admitted but exec identity is not yet published.
The verified child/process group is running.
The child was awaited and reaped.

ProcessView.description: Current status of a managed application child.

exit.description: Exit details present exactly when `state` is `exited`.

description:
Public, output-free terminal lifecycle event for one registered application.

The authenticated owner is deliberately absent from this wire shape. Event
routing applies that audience before serialization, and neither captured
stdout/stderr nor the identity of a termination requester is disclosed.

application.description: Stable image-owned application profile that produced the process.

forced_escalation.description: Whether graceful termination required SIGKILL escalation.

process.description: Exact reaped process identity and terminal status.

termination_requested.description: Whether managed TERM/KILL cleanup, rather than natural exit, was requested.

title: ProcessExitedEvent
